item: scripts/diff_installed_versions.py compares the Installed-versions blocks of two CI job logs (added, removed, changed pins and what moved in the environment line), so R349's "diff package versions first" is one command (R380 item 3)
summary: R349 said to diff the package versions of a green and a red job first, and R364 put the list at the tail of the test and Core-only logs; the comparison itself was still a by-eye pass over 87 to 109 lines. diff_installed_versions.py OLD NEW (each a log file or - for stdin; raw log with timestamps, step summary, or the get_job_logs JSON) finds the one block the step prints and reports changed, added, removed and unchanged packages by pip's name rule (PEP 503), and which of Python, runner image and kernel moved. Exit 0 identical, 1 different, 2 not comparable. It refuses to guess: no heading, no opening fence, a block with no closing fence before the log ends or before the next step starts (a ##[ line or Post job cleanup., even when a later step prints a bare fence), an empty block, two blocks in one log, JSON without logs_content, an unreadable path and closed stdin are each an error naming OLD or NEW and what was seen, never a comparison against an empty list (which would read as every package removed); a crash is exit 2, never exit 1. A non-pin line or a duplicate name is listed and makes the answer different unless both sides carry the same lines. Bytes that are not UTF-8 are replaced on both input routes. MEASURED on the two real Core-only tails, committed unedited under tests/fixtures/ci_logs (job 122649746920 of run 40638055096 and job 122725010413 of run 40661391305): 87 packages each, 0 changed, 0 added, 0 removed, while the environment line differs in all three fields (python 3.13.17 -> 3.13.16, runner image ubuntu24 20261026.354.1 -> 20261023.334.3, kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure -> 6.17.0-1022-azure) and the LATER run was on the OLDER image, so the header line is half the answer. tests/test_diff_installed_versions.py (100 tests) includes a drift guard that runs the real Installed versions step of both jobs in ci.yml under bash with a stub python and reads its output with the script. Mutants applied by hand to a scratch copy and named in the lesson: 40 of 41 script mutants fail a test (one is equivalent) and 10 of 10 CI-step mutants fail the drift guard; an independent read of the first version found the cut-off, stdin, exit-status and BOM gaps now closed. R379 correction riding this change: the wheel-layout lesson now carries the runner's measured figures (the step took 15 s on run 40661391305; the job 74 s against 50 s on run 40638055096) in place of the inferred ones; the 20.1 s build stays labelled as the sandbox figure. STATED LIMITS: it says which pins differ, not which caused a failure; it compares what pip list reports for the job given, only in the two jobs R364 names; a tail-limited reader must reach the heading; a log with another per-line prefix is refused with the first such line quoted, not read.
